value.rationale: The independent per-coupon erasure mechanism is an explicitly studied distinct model, whose original 2026 paper leaves a distribution-level critical-window gap. Nonmonotone completion involves path history, so matching mean loss rates does not itself yield a first-hit law. The result yields a quantitative pathwise universality theorem on the natural \(n\log n\) completion window, rather than merely restating a known clumsy limit. It thereby resolves a motivated stochastic-process question without claiming expectation convergence or an optimal error rate.
